title: Journal Entitled International Digest To Be Published

page_data.en:
FM. 2
G. 20M-1-35

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.I., Special Branch
REPORT

File No. S. B. D. 8041
Date September 1, 1937.

Subject Journal entitled "International Digest" to be published
by National Economic Security Enterprise Inc.

Made by D.S. Larby Forwarded by C. Crawford D. I.

With reference to the attached letter dated August 9,
1937, referring to the publication in Shanghai of a monthly
journal entitled "International Digest", enquiries at the
local office of National Economic Security Enterprise, Inc.,
211, Yuen Ming Yuen Road, publishers of the aforementioned
journal, indicate that the periodical will not be published
until the present hostilities have been concluded and until
conditions in the International Settlement have returned to
a state of normalcy.

An interview with Mr. C.A. Uy who states that he is
a travelling representative of the publishers revealed that
Mr. A.M. Yuzon, China Branch Manager of the Company, is at
present in the Philippine Islands. It was also learned from
Mr. Uy that no arrangements regarding the publication of the
International Digest will be made until further instructions
have been received from Mr. Yuzon in which case either Mr. Uy
or Mr. Yuzon will notify the Municipal Police.

D.S.L.
1/9.

D. S. Larby.
D. S.
D.C. (Crime & Special Branches).

File
DSR
2/9.

（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER 2 SEP. 1937 (CRIME BRANCH)）

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特别股（S.I., Special Branch）
报告

档案号 S. B. D. 8041
日期 1937年9月1日。

事由 关于由“国家经济安全企业股份有限公司”（National Economic Security Enterprise Inc.）出版的名为《国际文摘》（International Digest）的期刊。

制作者 D.S. Larby 转呈者 C. Crawford 督察长（D. I.）

兹就随附的1937年8月9日来信而言，该信提及在上海出版一份名为《国际文摘》的月刊一事。经向上述期刊的出版商“国家经济安全企业股份有限公司”位于圆明园路211号的本地办事处查询，获悉该期刊在目前敌对行动结束且公共租界局势恢复常态之前，将不予出版。

在与自称是出版商旅行代表的 Uy 先生（C.A. Uy）面谈后得知，该公司中国分公司经理 Yuzon 先生（A.M. Yuzon）目前身在菲律宾群岛。另从 Uy 先生处获悉，在收到 Yuzon 先生的进一步指示之前，不会就《国际文摘》的出版作出任何安排；届时，Uy 先生或 Yuzon 先生将通知工部局警务处。

D.S.L.
9月1日。

D. S. Larby.
D. S.
副总监（刑事及特别股）。

存档
DSR
9月2日。

（印：副总监 1937年9月2日 （刑事股））

Shanghai, August 9, 1937

The MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. M. C., Shanghai

Sir :

This is to inform you that we publishing a monthly digest, entitled INTERNATIONAL DIGEST, non-political and non-sectarian in nature, dwelling on topics of public interest like international relations, business, trade, finance, literature, etc. Our first issue will come out on September 1, 1937. We shall have the pleasure of sending you a copy of each and every issue of the digest.

We are a corporation incorporated under the laws of the Commonwealth of the Philippines, United States of America, with an authorized capital of one million pesos, Philippine currency, or around CNC $ 1,700,000.00. We are publishers of the Nese Journal in the Philippines with a circulation of or about fifty thousand, and intend to extend our publishing work in Shanghai and other leading cities of the Far East.

IMPORTANT: All money remittances should be made payable to the "NESE, INC." x x x Communications should be addressed to the General Manager at the Head Office or to Branch Manager of the province nearest to your address.

1937年8月9日

致 上海工部局警务处

先生：

特此告知，我方正在出版一份名为《国际文摘》（INTERNATIONAL DIGEST）的月刊，其性质非政治性且无宗派色彩，内容聚焦于国际关系、商业、贸易、金融、文学等公众感兴趣的话题。我们的首期将于1937年9月1日发行。我们将荣幸地向贵方赠送每一期《文摘》。

我方是一家依据美利坚合众国菲律宾自治领法律注册成立的公司，授权资本为一百万比索（菲律宾货币），约合法币1,700,000.00元。我方在菲律宾出版《Nese期刊》，发行量约为五万份，并计划将出版业务扩展至上海及远东其他主要城市。

重要提示：所有汇款请抬头写为“NESE, INC.” xxx 通信请寄至总部总经理或距离您地址最近的省份的分店经理。
